items.title: James Moody — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Mac said, 'Moody, why don't you learn your changes?' ... He says, 'I'll show you.' ... me and Mac would be on the floor. He said, 'Now, this, see, this is a F and this is a F7...'

ctx.x: -- I guess, yeah. But then -- and I never will forget -- Mac said, "Moody, why don't you learn your changes?" I said, "Nobody's [indiscernible]." He says, "I'll show you." I said, "Oh, beautiful!" So at night, everybody would be sleeping and me and Mac would be on the floor. He said, "Now, this, see, this is a F and this is a F7, and this is…." "Oh, yeah, Mac, man."
